My biggest concern is the limited dialogue options. Not really knowing exactly what the protagonist is going to say when you click on one of the options, just look at this image for instance http://i.imgur.com/zXbeTEZ.jpg - There is a option that says "Owner?", is he going to ask "Where is your owner?" or "Who is your owner?" ? Not knowing EXACTLY what choices you are making before you make them is a terrible design choice, and it's all because of they decided to add voice actors to the protagonists. It just feels too simplified and dumbed down to the same level as the Mass Effect dialogue wheel. I mean just look at the previous Fallout games dialogue options: http://i.imgur.com/IygQgOk.jpg, http://i.imgur.com/NzPg8Hv.png.

Another big fear I have is just how immersion breaking voice acted protagonists are going to be. One of the great things about the fallout games has been immersion, you embody the protagonist as you explore the world, interact with its inhabitants and complete missions etc. But I fear that not being able to choose exactly what the protagonist is going to say as well as hearing a voice speak in your stead is going to make Fallout 4 feel like many other games, that you are a 3rd person listening in on a conversation, and that is worrying to me.

The Fallout franchise has been one of my most favorite gaming franchises of all time, and I'm going to get Fallout 4 regardless as it still excites me, but I REALLY HOPE that there is going to be a mod on PC that mutes or cuts out the voice of the protagonist, and replaces the simple dialogue options with the options of what the voiced protagonist actually says so you can make more informed decisions. If I hear that a mod like that is going to be worked on, I would gladly wait a few extra weeks until it is released before I play the game myself.

TLDR: Limited and dumbed down dialogue options and voiced protagonists are bad, will still buy the game regardless, hoping for a mod that fixes it and makes the dialogues better.
